summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its quarterly information for the period ended March 31, 2026, comprising an interim financial review report. The filing contains no special-situation event; it is purely a routine periodic report of financial results. The registrant is Braskem S.A., a Brazilian chemical company, and the filing is a foreign private issuer's equivalent of a quarterly report under US securities laws. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change events described. This filing is standard periodic disclosure with no transformative corporate action.
